label: JV-880 ROMs
description: Your own Roland JV-880 v1.0.0 ROM dump (v1.0.1 does not work). Both program ROMs and both wave ROMs are needed; the NVRAM is optional.

rules.label: Program ROM 1
rules.note: Must be from a v1.0.0 unit. Program ROM 1 and the NVRAM are both 32 KB: keep the names jv880_rom1.bin and jv880_nvram.bin.

rules.label: Program ROM 2
rules.note: Must be from a v1.0.0 unit.

rules.label: Wave ROM 1
rules.note: Both wave ROMs are 2 MB: keep the names jv880_waverom1.bin and jv880_waverom2.bin.

rules.label: Wave ROM 2
rules.note: Both wave ROMs are 2 MB: keep the names jv880_waverom1.bin and jv880_waverom2.bin.

rules.label: NVRAM (optional)
rules.note: Saved patches and performances. Not needed: the plugin writes it when you save.

label: SR-JV80 expansion cards (optional)
description: Your own SR-JV80 card dumps. Several can be loaded at once.
